title: x402 actors and trust boundaries
caption: Four trust zones: the client holds the key and its own spend limits, the seller runs the middleware and the handler, the facilitator verifies and settles, and the network moves the funds. On Lightning the client pays the invoice itself and settle only checks the preimage. Discovery services are public and optional. Numbers follow the main flow.
alt: Flowchart. The client zone holds the client or agent, its wallet key and spendControls. The client sends a request to the x402 middleware in the seller zone and gets 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED, signs with the wallet key, and retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The middleware calls the facilitator zone: POST /verify, which only reads the token contract, and POST /settle, which broadcasts to the token contract and pays gas. For the Lightning binding the client pays the invoice itself, and settle only checks the preimage and records the payment hash. The middleware reads GET /supported at startup. The client can find resources through the Bazaar discovery endpoint and x402scan.
